data.name: Torin
data.gender_notes: Torin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Irish name 'Tadhg' meaning 'God's love'. The name Torin is a variant and means 'Little Thor'. Thor was the Norse god of thunder and strength. The name Torin carries the meaning “Little Thor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Torin usually hope their child will grow to embody little thor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, courage, and divine protection.
data.etymology: Torin belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Thor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Torin total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

Torin's name carries these spiritual qualities, offering a powerful connection to the past and a foundation for living a meaningful life grounded in faith, determination, and love.
